sourceTitle: Italian Style Meat Loaf Or Meatballs
sourceText:
Italian Style Meat Loaf Or Meatballs
By: Anonymous
Published: Sunday, December 13, 2009 - 12:02am

Ingredients




1 pound ground chuck
3/4 cup Italian seasoned bread crumbs
2 tablespoons grated Parmesan cheese
1 egg
1 sm. can tomato sauce
sm. amount olive oil for frying

Preparation

1 Mix ground chuck, bread crumbs, Parmesan cheese and egg. Shape loaf or meat balls. For meatballs, fry until brown in enough olive oil to keep balls from sticking to pan. For meat loaf place in pan. Pour tomato sauce over loaf. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes to 1 hour.
